body:
S206-54 closed: PAPERCRAFT's first real live player, end to end. Real live-service deployment (papercraft-server.service systemd unit, PAPERCRAFT_TICKET_SECRET added to IDUNA, IDUNA rebuilt in place after finding the deployed binary predated the papercraft ticket handler's own commit), a firewall opened for 7799/udp+7070/tcp+8080/tcp (verified externally via check-host.net from multiple regions), PLAY_ONLINE.bat/.sh (real public host flags baked in via okemily.com), papercraft_client.log (file-based logging, necessary since PLAY_ONLINE's console closes on exit), verbose [http] diagnostic logging in http_client.h (both Windows and POSIX branches), and the real bug that logging found: a genuine WSAStartup ordering bug (WSA error 10093) that had nothing to do with the extensive firewall/DNS investigation that preceded it. Then a real design flaw found from live play on the founder's own 5G connection: movement input was gated on the same flag that flips false during any connection hiccup -- redesigned to a three-tier model (continuous input via a sticky ever_welcomed flag, a small non-disruptive weak-connection indicator, a 20s last-resort full reconnect). v0.1.0 through v0.8.0 shipped across this arc.

⚓ ☃
title: S206-54: first real live player, end to end (v0.1.0-v0.8.0)
